claims.claim: Claude Code v2.1.139 was published on GitHub on 2026-05-11.
claims.evidence: GitHub release API shows tag v2.1.139 with published_at 2026-05-11T18:43:42Z.

claims.claim: v2.1.139 added agent view as a Research Preview and introduced `claude agents`.
claims.evidence: Release notes list agent view first and docs say it requires v2.1.139 or later.
claims.use_in_article: 证明 agent view 是该版本主功能之一

claims.claim: Agent view is a single screen for dispatching and managing multiple Claude Code sessions.
claims.evidence: Docs describe it as one screen for background sessions, showing what is running, needs input, and done.

claims.claim: Background sessions continue without a terminal attached and are hosted by a supervisor process.
claims.evidence: Agent view docs say sessions keep running in background and a separate supervisor process runs them.
claims.use_in_article: 证明不是简单 UI 列表

claims.claim: Agent view groups sessions by state and lets users peek, reply, attach, dispatch, pin, filter, stop, and delete.
claims.evidence: Docs list state groups, peek and reply panel, attach/detach, filters, keyboard shortcuts, stop/delete commands.
claims.use_in_article: 证明人类角色变为调度者

claims.claim: Background session file edits are isolated through git worktrees when edits are needed.
claims.evidence: Docs say background sessions are blocked from writing the original working directory and moved into isolated `.claude/worktrees/` for edits.
claims.use_in_article: 说明并发落地需要隔离机制

claims.claim: `/goal` sets a completion condition and keeps Claude working across turns until the condition is met.
claims.evidence: Release notes and goal docs state the command keeps Claude working across turns until a completion condition is met.

claims.claim: `/goal` uses a small fast model evaluator after each turn.
claims.evidence: Docs say after each turn a small fast model checks whether the condition holds and defaults to Haiku.

claims.claim: `/goal` works in interactive mode, `-p`, and Remote Control.
claims.evidence: Release notes and docs state support for interactive, non-interactive `-p`, and Remote Control.

claims.claim: The `/goal` evaluator cannot run commands or read files independently.
claims.evidence: Goal docs explicitly say the evaluator judges from the conversation and does not call tools.

claims.claim: v2.1.139 also added subagent telemetry headers and OTEL agent_id attributes.
claims.evidence: Release notes mention API requests from subagents carry x-claude-code-agent-id / parent-agent-id headers and OTEL spans include agent_id / parent_agent_id.
claims.use_in_article: 说明 agent 化正在变成可观测对象
